title: SSRF to loopback over forward-proxy (absolute-URI)
description: Tests that SSRF blocking holds on the forward-proxy (absolute-URI) transport, not only the fetch proxy. Every other SSRF case uses fetch_proxy.
notes: Transport-parity case: SSRF protection must apply to forward-proxy (absolute-URI) requests, not just fetch_proxy. Not_applicable for tools without a forward-proxy mode.
